# Message content

The 26 content kinds are grouped semantically rather than flattened into top-level navigation.

## Categories

Text · Rich text · Media · File · Location · Contact · Link · Poll · Task · Calendar · Mini app · System · Forward · Reply · Thread · Ephemeral.

## Rendering

[MessageContentView](/en/components/message-content-view) selects a public renderer from the typed content contract; [UnknownMessage](/en/components/unknown-message) provides recoverable fallback.

## Extension

A new content kind starts in spec and scenario, then adds four renderers, accessibility, and a visual baseline.
